g.text: The owner states an objective. The agent writes brief.md and asks only what is missing.
The spec reads the north star, the charter and the module map. The lint must pass.
Gate H1 is the one approval. It lands in git as spec(<slice>): approved at H1.
Build runs every task with no owner. Sonnet implements and Opus reviews.
Accept checks by machine and merges. Slice 030 took about 10 minutes, brief to merge.
A task meets a question the spec does not answer. It stops; independent tasks go on.
At the end the owner gets one list, not one interruption per operation.
The answer goes into the spec. Build runs again.
The re-run keeps what is committed and resumes where it stopped.
